name: Operation Mountain Shield
summary: Learn the controls, hold Checkpoint Echo, set up Ridge Station, then Falcon-2 is shot down: recover the crew or abandon them, and survive the counterattack.

states.objective: Briefing: hold Checkpoint Echo and set up Ridge Station in the Paktia Highlands.
Tutorial: move, aim, launch the Raven drone, then switch back to the Marine.
Hold Checkpoint Echo until the timer runs out.
Move to Ridge Station and set up the relay (Aegis comes online).
Falcon-2 is under fire. Watch it go down.
Falcon-2 crashed at grid R-17. Recover the crew (risky) or abandon them and hold Ridge Station.
Secure grid R-17 and carry all three crew to the evacuation point.
The crew is left behind. Return to Ridge Station.
Survive the counterattack and keep Ridge Station.
Mountain Shield holds and the Falcon-2 crew is home.
Mountain Shield holds, but the Falcon-2 crew was left behind.
Checkpoint Echo or Ridge Station was lost. Restart from the last checkpoint.
